items.heading: Riz Gras
details: Key ingredients: rice, tomato, meat, onion, palm oil
Brown meat pieces with onion in palm oil.
Stir in tomato paste and simmer into a rich sauce.
Add rice and enough water, cooking until the rice absorbs the sauce.
Fluff and serve the rice hot with the meat.

items.heading: Babenda
details: Key ingredients: leafy greens, peanut paste, dried fish, okra
Simmer dried fish and okra in water until softened.
Stir in ground peanut paste to thicken the base.
Add finely chopped leafy greens and cook until wilted.
Serve the thick green sauce over rice or millet balls.
